title: Rents

Rents

F.M.V. 332

145. The payment of rent for buildings occupied for public purposes is regulated by item no. 24 of Appendix X, Volume V of the Handbook and items 5 and 23 of Appendix IV of this volume.

NOTE—The powers of authorities of the department to sanction other regularly recurring expenditure are detailed in Appendix IV and Volume I of the Handbook.
